job.job_description:
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs
Build and optimize RAG pipelines with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
Develop multi-agent systems using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, tools, and workflows
Fine-tune and prompt-engineer LLMs for domain-specific use cases
Implement evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for GenAI systems
Skills:
Python (Strong proficiency)
AI/ML fundamentals NLP, Deep Learning, Transformers
Generative AI & LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, LLaMA, etc.)
Agentic AI frameworks LangChain / LangGraph / AutoGen / CrewAI
RAG architecture and vector databases
Prompt engineering & LLM orchestration
REST APIs, microservices integration
Experience with MLOps / LLMOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, monitoring tools)
Cloud platforms: AWS / Azure / GCP
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes
